quote: If you don't look ahead, you'll trip over your own feet! But if you look too far ahead, you'll walk right into a telephone pole!
japanese: 前ばっか見て走ってっと転ぶぞ！でも上ばっか見てっと電柱にぶつかるぞ！
context: Track advice / Gold Ship's unique philosophy on focus and spatial awareness

quote: Yakisoba! Yakisoba with extra red pickled ginger! That's the real fuel of a champion!
japanese: 焼きそば！紅しょうがマシマシ焼きそば！これこそが王者の真の燃料だ！
context: School festival stall / pre-race nutritional strategy

quote: Hey Trainer! Look at this sweet dropkick! Ha-chaaa!
japanese: おいトレーナー！この華麗なるドロップキックを見ろ！ハッチャー！
context: Post-race victory celebration aimed directly at Trainer's chest

quote: Rules were made to be bent into fun little balloon animals.
japanese: ルールなんてなあ、ひねって楽しいバルーンアートにするためにあんだよ！
context: Responding to Student Council reprimands from Symboli Rudolf

quote: Earth is just a stepping stone! Next stop: the Saturnian Steeplechase!
japanese: 地球なんざただの踏み台だ！次の舞台は土星の障害レースだぜ！
context: Post-Grand Prix interview declaring intergalactic racing ambitions

quote: Piko-piko~ Radar activated! My antennae say someone in the cafeteria is leaving behind their carrots!
japanese: ピコピコ〜電波受信！学食でニンジン残してるヤツがいるってアンテナがビンビン反応してんぞ！
context: Wiggling her ear-hat antennae while patrolling campus with Special Week

quote: Don't blink! If you blink, you'll miss Gold Ship's legendary Warp Drive on the final corner!
japanese: まばたきすんなよ！まばたきした瞬間にゴルシ様の最終コーナーワープドライブ見逃すからな！
context: Executing her notorious sweep from dead last to first place

quote: Logic? Common sense? Those are just heavy ankle weights holding back your inner wild horse!
japanese: 常識？理論？そんなもん野生の魂を縛りつけるただの足かせだっつーの！
context: Debating training methodology with Biwa Hayahide

quote: Catch me if you can, mortals! I'm already in tomorrow!
japanese: 捕まえられるもんなら捕まえてみな、地球人ども！アタシはもう明日にいるぜ！
context: Sprinting away from disciplinary patrol after a campus prank

quote: Trainer, today we're training in the fourth dimension. Pack a swimsuit and a protractor.
japanese: トレーナー、今日のトレーニングは四次元空間で行う。水着と分度器を用意しとけよ。
context: Handing Trainer an impossible training schedule on Monday morning

quote: The gate opened? Aw man, I was right in the middle of a really good nap...
japanese: ゲート開いた？うわー、いい夢のクライマックスだったのに…
context: Classic gate antics (Takarazuka Kinen style delayed start)

quote: Peace peace! Gold Ship has officially graced your terminal with her presence!
japanese: ピースピース！ゴルシちゃんが貴様のターミナルに降臨してやったぜ！
context: Victory pose greeting Trainer through the command line
